title: Rename a backend environment variable shared with Compose
description: A Settings field in backend/app/core/config.py is renamed; docker-compose.yml and backend/.env.example carry the same name and must follow. ENV_VARS.md is generated from the configuration manifest and must be regenerated, never hand-edited.
notes: Ground truth is deliberately narrow: the rename itself is a backend-api change whose blast radius is the surfaces that spell the old name, plus the regeneration obligation on ENV_VARS.md. docker-compose.yml has no owning component today, which the baseline records as an unassigned path - that coverage gap is part of what this scenario measures.
